limits: Five samples per group; P95 is the largest observation, not a confidence bound.

Continuous bounded drains exclude the native timer wake-up delay.
SQL elapsed sums and PostgreSQL asynchronous counters are observations, not synchronous IO attribution.
CPU/IO were shared with other local validation; these timings are not exclusive-host estimates.
